title: Ender's Game
description: After an alien invasion, an unlikely recruit commands Earth's forces and fights for the future of humanity.

title: Kin
description: On the run from a Detroit crime boss, an ex-con and his adopted brother use a high-tech gun to battle an army of thugs and two heavily armored, futuristic soldiers who want their weapon back.

title: Source Code
description: A helicopter pilot (Jake Gyllenhaal) takes part in a secret government program that enables him to assume someone's identity and experience the last few minutes of that person's life.

title: Vice
description: A self-aware, artificial human (Ambyr Childers) becomes caught in the crossfire between a cop (Thomas Jane) and the creator (Bruce Willis) of an exclusive resort where paying customers play out their wildest fantasies.

title: Bleeding Steel
description: Hong Kong police inspector Lin Dong learns that a biochemical invention has been surgically implanted into his missing daughter. With help from a hacker, Lin tries to connect the dots between the device, a sinister army and a strange phenomenon.

title: 24 Hours to Live
description: After a mercenary dies in a brutal firefight, a new regenerative surgery gives him a second chance at life and another shot at redemption.

title: Raw Deal
description: A former FBI agent (Arnold Schwarzenegger) infiltrates the biggest mob in Chicago and single-handedly wipes it out.

title: Sisu
description: During the last days of World War II, a solitary prospector crosses paths with Nazis on a scorched-Earth retreat in northern Finland. When the soldiers decide to steal his gold, they quickly discover they just tangled with no ordinary miner.

title: Silent Night
description: On Christmas Eve, a man witnesses the death of his young son when the boy gets caught in crossfire between warring gangs. Recovering from a wound that cost him his voice, he soon embarks on a bloody and grueling quest to punish those responsible.

title: Mechanic: Resurrection
description: Bishop's most formidable foe kidnaps the love of his life in order to make him complete three impossible assassinations and make them look like accidents.

title: Transporter 3
description: Mob courier Frank Martin and the subject of his assignment, a cynical Ukrainian woman, are fitted with shackles that will explode if they wander too far from his car.

title: The Package
description: Assassins dog the trail of a mob enforcer (Steve Austin) who's been entrusted to deliver a special parcel to an international crime lord known as the German (Dolph Lundgren).

description: A recently released convict and his criminally inclined best friend execute a daring daytime bank robbery.

title: Man on a Ledge
description: While trying to convince a disgraced ex-cop (Sam Worthington) to come in from a high-rise ledge, a police negotiator (Elizabeth Banks) begins to realize that the man has an ulterior motive.

title: Hot Seat
description: Sitting on an explosive device, a former hacker and IT expert must steal digital funds online for a mysterious voice on an intercom. His only hope of survival comes from a bomb squad officer who must figure out a way to outwit the evil plan.

title: Force of Nature
description: A policeman and a former cop battle a gang of thieves as they search for $55 million inside an evacuated building during a hurricane.

title: The Forger
description: An art forger (John Travolta) arranges an early release from prison so that he can spend time with his dying son, then must pull off one final job for the man who made his freedom possible.

description: A veteran detective and a rookie cop have to stop a master thief's computer virus before it drains all the funds from a bank's accounts.

title: The Expendables

title: The Expendables 2
description: Mercenary Barney Ross and his team cut a swath of destruction through opposing forces as they take revenge for the vicious murder of a comrade.

title: The Expendables 3
description: After a former associate makes it his mission to end the Expendables, Barney Ross (Sylvester Stallone) assembles a team of younger, tech-savvy recruits to help take down their enemy.

title: The Expendables 4
description: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.
